## TabResourceClient.get() method

Read the tab at the zero-based position `index` within `windowId`<!-- -->. A tab has no id, so it is selected by its zero-based position within its window, which drifts when tabs open, close or move.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(windowId: Integer, index: Integer, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Tab>;
```
